_comment: Copy to products.json and edit, then run the seed script. Until products.json
exists, redeemPurchase refuses every receipt with 'product is not configured',
which is the correct behaviour before any real store products exist.
The keys MUST be the product ids exactly as configured in App Store Connect and
the Play Console. The amount is what the server grants — it is deliberately not
in the app, because a client that names its own reward names any number it likes.
